from dataclasses import dataclass
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class P:
    x: int
p0 = P(1)
less = lambda b: 1 < b
between = lambda b: 0 <= 1 < b
pick = lambda b: (b if True else 0)
nand = lambda b: not (True and b)
pair = lambda b: [1, b]
tup = lambda b: (1, b)
label = lambda b: f"x{1}y{b}"
shadow = lambda b: lambda a: a + b
close = lambda b: lambda c: 1 + b + c
hex = lambda b: int("ff", base=b)
field = lambda b: p0.x + b
neg = lambda b: -1 + b
has = lambda b: "x" in b
size = lambda b: len("x") + b
addTen = shadow(10)
addThree = close(2)
print((less(2), between(5), pick(7), nand(False), pair(2), tup(3), label(4)))
print((addTen(20), addThree(3), hex(16), field(5), neg(3), has("axe"), size(2)))
